rule: Sam, 2026-11-17, relayed by COBIx on #3358 section 2: collect with gaps noted and confidence scores; Commons Clarity's Part B (#3480, comment 6967374303); COBIx's D2 decision (major total differs, about 30); Sam's routine prompt of 2026-11-25, as the S739 conductor's brief carries it: a record held for a gap is collected with its gap named and a lower score on the 0-100 bar, never held, unless the record is not the program's own; S739: Santa Ana's records kb/receipts/program_requirement_records_piles_s739_santa_ana_2026-11-26_s740r2.json held, read again by key: passed by a rescore where today's scorer's one reading moves them, else collected with their gaps named where the record is the program's own (no reread, no reconcile)

gaps.units_within_printed_range: The courses' units as read fall within the printed range of units rather than matching it.

records.award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units
records.words: the courses' units add to 24.5-29, within the printed 24-30 units | A '20.0' subtotal is printed after PHAR 048; it matches the sum of PHAR 055, 051, 052, 056, 057 and 060 (20 units). All seven lecture courses are recorded as one required block; the 24.0-30.0 'Required Courses' figure is recorded as the certificate total.

before_image.award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Pharmacy Technology Advanced Option: Certificate of Achievement (Transcripted)
outcomes: Develop a polished resume for Pharmacy Technician job interviews, highlighting your advanced technical skills.
Apply and complete Pharmacy Technician Certification Board Exam successfully.
Apply for the California Board of Pharmacy application for licensing as a Pharmacy Technician in a timely manner.

records.words: the courses' units add to 19-19.5, within the printed 18-19.5 units | List A allows any core course not selected from the Required Core plus one listed course, or two listed courses; List B allows any course not selected above or a listed course. These cross-list options are not encoded in the blocks.

program.section_heading: Political Science: A.A.-T Degree for Transfer

representation: checks.gaps and checks.confidence added as the load reads the filed score (a passing row: checks.arithmetic to equal); checks.coverage, invented and the record unchanged
claim_check_reads: Today's capture (sources.json): every course an entry names among the codes it found, and a course an entry says the printed total leaves out on neither it nor the state's list. A note's quoted figures are the reader's words, never re-read here.
follow_verdict: The follow_verdict trigger marks a row checked when its latest verdict is a confirm whose fingerprint matches the record and the machine checks pass. The record is unchanged here, so such a confirm on a row this plan moves to passing would check it at the apply, and the rollback would skip it. The pre-read counts those rows (confirm_matches); the apply aborts, writing nothing, unless the count is 0.

update public.program_requirement_records r
   set checks = v.before_checks
  from v
 where r.college = v.college and r.control_number = v.control_number
   and r.extracted_run = v.extracted_run and r.checks = v.after_checks
   and r.checked is not true
returning v.i),
s as (select count(*) as n, coalesce(json_agg(i order by i), '[]'::json) as keys from u)
select case when s.n = e.expect - c.n
            then json_build_object('returned', s.n, 'keys', s.keys, 'skipped_checked', c.keys)
            else ('s741k1 piles rollback guard: the UPDATE matched ' || s.n || ' rows, the plan names ' || (e.expect - c.n))::int::text::json end as returned
  from s, c, e;
